description: The consistency tag and what a goal's row shows (decisions 19, 21 and 32). Daily-rhythm goals (days, weekdays, occasions) count kept due days among the last 30; period goals count met periods among the last 12. Today, or the current period, counts only once kept or met. No tag before 7 due days or 4 periods. Devoted at 90% or more, Steady at 80% or more. The row shows the streak when it's 3 or more; otherwise the tag if there is one; otherwise a streak of 1 or 2; otherwise nothing.

hijri_corrections.description: The account's Hijri month-start corrections. Absent means none.

show.description: What the goal's row shows: 🔥 and the streak, the tag ("Steady · 25/30"), or neither.

cases.description: Six due days, all met: too early for a tag, so the row shows the streak.
Seven due days, all met: Devoted, but the streak of 7 is shown first.
25 of the last 30 due days, and yesterday missed: "Steady · 25/30" replaces the 🔥.
23 of 30 is below 80%: no tag, and no streak to show.
27 of 30 is exactly 90%: Devoted. A new streak of 2 days isn't enough to replace the tag.
A new streak reaches 3 days: the row shows 🔥 again.
September was all missed, but only the last 30 due days count.
Today is already met, so the window is the 30 days up to today, leaving out the missed 1 October.
Today isn't met yet: the window is the 30 days before it.
Paused and excused days aren't due, so they aren't counted.
A day made up the next day counts as met.
Days at the minimum kept the streak, so they count.
Every Friday since 5 June: 20 of 22 met, last Friday missed.
A weekly total: 10 of the last 12 finished weeks met, and last week missed. This week is in progress and not met, so it's left out.
This week is already met, so it counts, and the oldest of the 12 drops out.
Three weeks met: too early for a tag.
A tracker counts days with any count.
